I added a sleep between sandbox calls in `tests/test_payments.py`. I haven't run the test, because it calls the real external sandbox.

- **Spacing:** the loop now waits 0.25s before each call except the first. A 5 requests per second limit means calls need to be at least 0.2s apart, so 0.25s leaves some margin. The four calls add about 0.75s to the test.
- **Easy to change:** the delay is a named constant, `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL`, next to a comment explaining the rate limit.

I also saved the 5 requests per second sandbox limit to project memory, so future tests that call the sandbox will account for it.

If more tests start calling the sandbox, a shared fixture or a retry on 429 (rate-limited) responses would hold up better than fixed sleeps in each test.
